title: A Warm Room for Grandma June
subtitle: The first snow falls. Jo's grandmother says she's fine. Her old heater says otherwise.
end: Is the Dreo heater right for your room? Our full review is below.
style: Winter palette: deep blue snowy nights against warm amber interior light.

art.prompt: Establishing shot at night: first snow falling over a small gray wooden one-story house with a pitched snowy roof, a front porch and one front window on a quiet street; one window glows warm amber; soft blue moonlight; peaceful but lonely. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

items.text: The first snow of the year. Jo's grandmother lives alone.

art.prompt: Inside the small house: June sits in an old armchair wrapped in a thick blanket, holding a smartphone up for a video call and smiling bravely, though her breath is faintly visible in the cold room. An old, worn metal space heater glows dimly near her feet. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

items.text: Don't fuss, dear. I have my old heater.

art.prompt: Close-up of Jo's face in her city apartment at night, lit by the cool glow of a video call from below (the phone itself is out of frame), eyes narrowing with worry, lips pressed; city lights behind her. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple dark background for lettering.

items.text: Grandma... what is that heater plugged into?

art.prompt: Dramatic close-up at floor level: an old space heater's plug pushed into a cheap, dusty power strip and a frayed extension cord running under the edge of a fringed blanket; an ominous red-orange glow and a few small sparks at the power strip. Tense, warning mood, dark background. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

items.text: CPSC: never plug a space heater into an extension cord or a power strip.

art.prompt: Over-the-shoulder view from behind Jo at her desk late at night: we see the back of her auburn bob and teal cardigan and, beyond her, the laptop's screen glowing with an abstract blurry grid of product tiles (nothing readable); a framed photo of Jo and her grandmother on the desk; her hand on the trackpad, determined. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple dark wall for lettering.

items.text: She's getting a new one. Tonight.

art.prompt: Vera appears beside a glowing floating checklist hologram with three blank lines, one hand raised like a teacher making a point, calm and confident; soft blue light around her. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

items.text: Good call. One check before you buy any heater this winter.

art.prompt: Close-up of two hands holding a small rectangular black ceramic space heater tilted back to read the blank white rating sticker on its underside; focused warm light on the blank sticker, dark background. Keep the top third of the frame as simple dark background for lettering.

items.text: Find the model number on the label, then look it up in the recall notice.
Source: CPSC notice 27-054. The Dreo in our review is a different model; check yours against the notice.

art.prompt: Snowy evening at the front door of the small house: Jo, snow on her coat, holds a plain unbranded cardboard box; June opens the door, overjoyed, arms wide to hug her. Warm light spills from inside. Emotional reunion. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

Jo kneels and plugs a compact black ceramic heater directly into a wall outlet in a cozy living room; the heater stands on the bare floor with clear empty space around it, far from the curtains and the armchair. Clean, safe, warm. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

items.text: Straight into the wall. Three feet clear of drapes, furniture and bedding (CPSC).

art.prompt: Close-up of June's hand pressing a button on a small remote control, the heater's soft orange glow in the background, June smiling in the warm light. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

items.text: Set it near 68°F. In Eco mode it stops heating once the room gets there (Dreo).

art.prompt: Heartwarming night scene: June in her armchair holding a mug of tea, Jo sitting on the floor leaning her head on her grandmother's knee, both smiling with eyes closed in the warm amber glow; snow falling outside the window. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple, uncluttered background (wall, ceiling, night sky or soft gradient) with no faces in it, for lettering.

Final quiet shot from outside at night: a small gray wooden one-story house with a pitched snowy roof, a front porch and one front window, in falling snow, its window glowing warm amber; the porch light switches off. Peaceful, tender ending. Composition: keep the top third of the frame as simple night sky for lettering.

items.text: Off when you sleep or leave: CPSC and NFPA both say so. Goodnight, Grandma.
